newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian T-bill rate falls in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian T-bill rate falls in liquid market.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury on Monday said it sold 17.5 million dinars ($17.5 million) of 13-week bills at its weekly auction dated January 21, repaying maturing paper totalling 61 million dinars.
The issue was at 7.5000 percent, down from 7.8125 percent two weeks ago.
The slide came as the interbank rate fell to 6.875 percent from 7.8125 percent in a highly liquid market and also reflected the rise of the amount banks offered this week for treasury paper.
Banks bid for 456 million dinars of 13-, 26-, 52-week and two-, three-year paper at between 7.5000 and 8.000 percent. ($=one dinar)
